annotation.title_clean: 商务部等7部门关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions of the Ministry of Commerce and Six Other Departments on Promoting the Expansion and Upgrading of Goods Consumption
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China and six other departments
annotation.venue: Ministry of Commerce of the PRC
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued implementation opinions (Aug 2026) to expand and upgrade goods consumption during the 15th Five-Year Plan. They target about 60 trillion yuan in retail sales by 2030 and promote green, smart and health consumption, including cultural, sports and 3D-printing goods. Robotics is not addressed.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target retail sales of consumer goods of about 60 trillion yuan by 2030
Cultivate trillion-yuan-scale markets in green, smart and health consumption
Promote consumption of bulk durables such as autos, home appliances and communications equipment
Expand consumption of cultural, sports and smart musical instrument products and 3D printing
Strengthen IP protection for designs and trademarks in IP-derived products
